title: OmniVia Chat Runtime Contract v1 - CommitMessageAmendment
description: Closes CGAP-042-006. Normative wire shapes for the idempotent `CommitMessageAmendment` command exactly as ADR-022 §6 and REF-042 §13.3-§13.6 define it. The command's atomic commit boundary covers Message, derivation, branch, head event, view state, Generation Job, Audit and outbox records (REF-042 §13.3, Appendix C; ADR-022 §4.8). A validation or permission failure before commit creates no Message or branch (REF-042 §13.5). Exact command replay by `commandId` is idempotent and returns the original committed result (REF-042 §13.6, §21.2, REF042-INV-015, ADR022-INV-015); conflicting reuse of `commandId` with different content fails as an idempotency conflict and creates no new graph state (REF-042 §21.3, REF042-INV-016).

EditablePartInput.title: EditablePartInput
EditablePartInput.description: One caller-supplied Message Part for the amended Message's canonical editable content (REF-042 §13.3). The server assigns `partId`, `index`, `contentHash` and `createdAt`; `visibility` defaults to `standard` for user-authored amendment input when absent.

payload.description: Type-specific closed payload envelope, owned by the Chat Part-type registry (out of scope for REF-042 and this contract per REF-042 §2.2).

CommitMessageAmendmentRequest.title: CommitMessageAmendmentRequest
CommitMessageAmendmentRequest.description: Conceptual request exactly as REF-042 §13.3 and ADR-022 §6 define it. Closes CGAP-042-006.

expectedSourceContentHash.description: Optional optimistic pre-commit check. When supplied and mismatched, the command fails as `source_content_hash_mismatch` (REF-042 §13.3 step 5).

clientObservedGraphRevision.description: Optional. Never itself an authority grant; used only as an optimistic staleness hint (REF-042 §13.3).

CommitMessageAmendmentResult.title: CommitMessageAmendmentResult
CommitMessageAmendmentResult.description: Conceptual successful result exactly as REF-042 §13.4 and ADR-022 §6 define it. `idempotentReplay` is `true` when this exact result was returned from a prior committed execution of the same `commandId` rather than a new commit (REF-042 §13.6, §21.2).

attachmentWarnings.description: Non-blocking reference issues surfaced with the successful commit (REF-042 §14.3). A blocking reference failure instead fails the command with `Failure.referenceFailures` (CGAP-042-010).

CommitMessageAmendmentFailure.title: CommitMessageAmendmentFailure
CommitMessageAmendmentFailure.description: The closed command-failure envelope for `CommitMessageAmendment`, reusing the shared `Failure` shape (REF-042 §13.5).
